shared_elements: a conveyance with occupants (chariot / boat with crew)
justification: Both surfaces show human figures, quadrupeds and a conveyance carrying multiple occupants (a horse-drawn chariot in A, crewed boats indicated by rows of strokes in B), but these are generic narrative staples rather than a shared distinctive motif. The manner of depiction differs completely: A is a naturalistic, modelled single-register frieze of overlapping figures with detailed anatomy, dress and equipment, while B consists of flat schematic silhouettes and stroke-signs (including footprint-like shapes) scattered across the surface without a common register or ground line.
